headline: Earnings per share jump on both comparisons
summary_short: Siemens Energy India's earnings per share were INR 18.33, up 48.1% from INR 12.38 in the prior quarter and up 81.5% from INR 10.10 a year earlier.
summary_long: The shard holds a single figure for this period: EPS of INR 18.33 from Yahoo's earnings chart, versus INR 12.38 in the prior quarter and INR 10.10 in the year-ago quarter. No revenue, margin or cash figures are on the shard for this period.
